data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'doron', meaning 'gift' or 'present'. Dorette is a diminutive form of Dorothy, meaning 'gift of God'. The name Dorette carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorette usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
